scientific_task: Collect experimentally reported composition, electrolyte, testing conditions, and performance metrics (overpotential, Tafel slope, stability) for inorganic or hybrid OER electrocatalysts tested under alkaline or acidic conditions, to enable comparison and identification of factors associated with low overpotential and high stability.

record_definition.one_record: One experimentally reported measurement of OER catalytic performance for a specific catalyst in a given electrolyte and set of testing conditions, extracted from a single source.
